csv_scope_of_work: The Town of Waxhaw, North Carolina, is now accepting Statements of Qualifications (SOQs) for Biennial Bridges & structures Inspections and Miscellaneous Design. This RFQ is for the selection of a vendor to perform Biennial Inspections for Non-DOT qualifying Bridges in public right of way. The selected vendor shall perform inspections every two years on town Non-NCDOT qualifying Bridges and Downtown Historic Pedestrian Bridge. Structure safety inspections will be performed in Page 2 accordance with National Bridge Inspection Standards and NCDOT requirements. Work will be performed under the direct supervision of a licensed Professional Engineer. Inspection teams will be led by an Inspection Team Leader. Throughout the contract additional designs and inspections of foot bridges and retaining walls may require the Professional services of the selected vendor.

title: Biennial Bridge & Structures Inspections & Design
short_description: RFQ for biennial bridge inspections and miscellaneous structural design services in Waxhaw.
project_scope: Biennial inspections of non-NCDOT qualifying bridges in the public right of way and the Downtown Historic Pedestrian Bridge in Waxhaw. Inspections must comply with National Bridge Inspection Standards and NCDOT requirements and be performed under the direct supervision of a licensed Professional Engineer with an Inspection Team Leader. The contract may also include additional inspections and design services for footbridges and retaining walls.
services: Biennial bridge and structure inspection services; miscellaneous design services; possible additional design and inspection services for footbridges and retaining walls; civil engineering; structural engineering; geotechnical engineering; surveying/GIS/mapping; traffic design engineering.
relevance_explanation:
- Includes bridge-related services, including a pedestrian bridge and possible footbridge design work.
- Structural inspection and miscellaneous design create some strategic relevance for sbp.
- However, the main focus is recurring inspection services rather than complex structural design.
- No information on large spans, innovative structures, or architecturally demanding elements.
- Includes retaining walls and multidisciplinary municipal services, which lowers direct fit.
construction_cost_explanation: No construction budget is stated in the source. The notice is primarily for professional inspection and miscellaneous design services for existing non-NCDOT bridges, a historic pedestrian bridge, footbridges, and retaining walls. No quantities, sizes, or planned construction measures are provided, so a realistic construction cost estimate is not possible.
fee_explanation: No fee or estimated contract value is stated in the source. The procurement is an RFQ for renewable professional services over a 72-month period covering biennial inspections and possible additional design tasks, but there is insufficient information to derive a reliable fee estimate.
references_qualifications: Work must be performed under the direct supervision of a licensed Professional Engineer. Inspection teams must be led by an Inspection Team Leader. Inspections must comply with National Bridge Inspection Standards and NCDOT requirements.
